title: SemEval-2023 Task 10: Explainable Detection of Online Sexism

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating baseline and participant machine learning models on their ability to classify social media comments into a hierarchical taxonomy of sexism (binary detection, 4 broad categories, and 11 fine-grained vectors) using macro-average F1 scores, accompanied by quantitative and qualitative error analyses of the models' misclassifications.
